response_json.generated_sql:
SELECT
  flow_direction,
  currency,
  COUNT(*) AS invoice_count,
  SUM(grand_total) AS total_grand_total
FROM invoice
WHERE tenant_id = '02db74f3-2064-4b3b-aec9-218af9a408f4'
  AND (
    LOWER(COALESCE(vendor_name, ''))   LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(customer_name, '')) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(file_path, ''))     LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(invoice_number, '')) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(po_number, ''))      LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(tags::text, ''))     LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(items::text, ''))    LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
  )
GROUP BY flow_direction, currency
ORDER BY currency, flow_direction;
